authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)

description.en: Every food business operator (FBO) holding an FSSAI license is required to file an annual return in Form D-1 through the FSSAI's FoSCoS (Food Safety Compliance System) portal. The annual return provides details of food categories handled, quantities manufactured or sold, and compliance with food safety standards. Filing is mandatory for all FSSAI licensees and must be completed by 31st May each year for the preceding financial year. Failure to file attracts penalties under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

verifiedConditions.claim: The food business operator must hold a valid FSSAI license (not just basic registration). FSSAI licensees with a 14-digit license number are required to file annual returns. Basic registration holders (with a 14-digit registration number) are exempt from annual return filing in most categories.

unverifiedEligibility: Some categories of basic registration holders may also be required to file returns depending on the nature and scale of operations.
Central license holders and state license holders may have different reporting requirements.
FBOs with multiple units/locations may need to file separate returns for each licensed unit.

requirements.claim: Valid FSSAI license number (14-digit) and login credentials for the FoSCoS portal. The license must be active (not expired, suspended, or cancelled).

Completed Form D-1 (Annual Return) with details including: food categories handled during the year, quantity of raw materials used, quantity of food manufactured/processed/sold, details of products recalled (if any), and information about food safety management systems implemented.

Laboratory analysis reports for food products manufactured during the year, conducted by FSSAI-recognised or NABL-accredited laboratories. Manufacturers of certain categories of food products must conduct periodic testing as specified in their license conditions.

Production or sales data for the financial year — quantities manufactured, stored, distributed, or sold, categorised by food product type. Revenue or turnover figures may also be required for certain categories.

processInformation.claim: Log in to the FoSCoS portal (foscos.fssai.gov.in) using the FSSAI license credentials. Navigate to the Annual Return section.
Fill in Form D-1 online with the required details — food categories, quantities, compliance information, and any product recall details. The form auto-populates some fields from the license details.

Upload any supporting documents (lab reports, if required) and submit the return. An acknowledgement is generated with a unique reference number. The submitted return can be viewed and downloaded from the portal.

output.claim: An acknowledgement receipt with a unique reference number confirming successful submission of the FSSAI annual return (Form D-1) through the FoSCoS portal. The acknowledgement serves as proof of compliance with the annual return filing requirement.

fees.claim: There is no fee for filing the FSSAI annual return itself. The return is filed as part of the compliance obligations under the existing FSSAI license, for which fees are paid separately at the time of license issuance or renewal.

processingTime.claim: The annual return is submitted online through the FoSCoS portal and the acknowledgement is generated instantly upon successful submission. The actual time to complete the form depends on the complexity of the food business and the availability of data.

sources.title: FoSCoS — Food Safety Compliance System
sources.publisher: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
sources.evidenceExcerpt: FoSCoS is FSSAI's online portal for license management, annual return filing, and compliance monitoring. The portal provides the Form D-1 template and guides for annual return submission. The deadline for annual return filing is 31st May of each year.
claimsSupported: Annual return filing is mandatory for FSSAI licensees.
Returns are filed online through FoSCoS portal in Form D-1.
Filing deadline is 31st May each year for the preceding financial year.
sources.uncertainty: Specific form fields and reporting requirements may be updated by FSSAI through notifications.

sources.title: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
sources.publisher: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
sources.evidenceExcerpt: Section 32 of the FSS Act, 2006 requires every licensee to submit returns in the prescribed form and within the prescribed time. Section 55 provides for penalties for failure to comply with provisions of the Act, including non-filing of returns.
claimsSupported: Annual return filing is a statutory requirement under FSS Act, 2006.
Failure to file returns attracts penalties.
Form D-1 is the prescribed annual return form.
sources.uncertainty: Penalty amounts and enforcement actions for non-filing may vary based on FSSAI directives and state food safety authority practices.

limitations: This record covers the general annual return filing requirement for FSSAI licensees. Specific reporting fields may vary based on the type of food business.
Laboratory testing requirements for manufacturers are not covered in detail as they vary by food category.
The record does not cover half-yearly returns that may be required for certain categories of food businesses.
State-level food safety authority procedures for return compliance monitoring are not detailed.
The record does not cover the consequences of non-filing (penalties, license suspension) in detail.
Special returns for importers, e-commerce FBOs, or food delivery platforms may have additional requirements.

review.reviewReason: Core filing requirement is well-established. Specific form fields and reporting categories need periodic verification as FSSAI updates requirements.
